description: This Dart source file defines the QuizProgressStore class, which manages the persistence and retrieval of quiz progress data using SharedPreferences. It provides methods to save results, fetch attempts, handle legacy data migration, and access the latest attempt for a specific quiz.

classes.name: QuizProgressStore
classes.description: A class that manages local storage of quiz progress, including saving results, retrieving attempts, and handling legacy data migration.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Initializes an instance of QuizProgressStore asynchronously by obtaining SharedPreferences instance.

methods.name: saveResult
methods.description: Saves the quiz result with details such as last score, total, completion status, and appends an attempt record.

methods.name: getResult
methods.description: Retrieves the saved result summary for a specific quiz, handling JSON decoding and errors.

methods.name: getAttempts
methods.description: Returns all attempt records for a given quiz, migrating legacy data if necessary.

methods.name: appendAttempt
methods.description: Appends a new attempt record to the existing list of attempts.

methods.name: getLastAttempt
methods.description: Returns the most recent attempt for a specific quiz.
